# Trip notes: Goa, December

We land on **14 December** and stay for "a week or so" -- longer if the weather holds.

## Packing

- [x] Passport
- [x] Sunscreen
- [ ] Charger

1. Beach on day one.
2. Fort Aguada, then dinner.
